description: Allow SVG file uploads using the WordPress Media Library uploader plus the ability to inline SVG files for direct styling/animation of SVG elements using CSS/JS.

name: WP Job Manager
description: WP Job Manager is a lightweight job listing plugin for adding job-board like functionality to your WordPress site.

name: Reign WP Job Manager Addon
description: Reign WP Job Manager Addon provides seemless integration of WP Job Manager with Reign theme.

name: WP Job Manager - Resume Manager
description: Resume Manager is a plugin built on top of WP Job Manager which adds a resume submission form to your site and resume listings, all manageable from WordPress admin.

name: WP Job Manager - Embeddable Job Widget
description: Show a form on your site that users can use to generate an embeddable job widget showing job listings from your site.

name: WP Job Manager - Bookmarks
description: Allow logged in candidates and employers to bookmark jobs and resumes along with an added note.

name: WP Job Manager - Applications
description: Allow candidates to apply to jobs using a form & employers to view and manage the applications from their job dashboard.

name: WP Job Manager - Alerts
description: Allow registered users to save their job searches and create alerts which send new jobs via email daily, weekly or fortnightly.

name: WP Job Manager - Apply with XING
description: Add an "Apply with XING" button to job listings which have an 'email' apply method. Requires API keys from XING (https://dev.xing.com/)

name: WP Job Manager - Apply with Facebook
description: Add an "Apply with Facebook" button to job listings which have an 'email' apply method. Requires an App on Facebook - please follow the documentation to set it up correctly.

name: WP Job Manager – Company Profiles
description: Outputs a list of all companies that have submitted jobs with links to their listings and profile.

name: Regions for WP Job Manager
description: Adds a “Job Region” taxonomy so the site administrator can control a set of predefined regions listings can be assigned to.

name: Job Colors for WP Job Manager
description: Select the color of each existing job type in the Job Listings’ settings. Can set the color to be the background color, or text color.

name: Contact Form 7

name: bbPress
